_howto: Put a notice in the strip under the nav by adding an object to items.
Required: date (YYYY-MM-DD) and text. Optional: url and linkText.
Anything dated more than 7 days ago stops showing by itself.
An empty items list shows nothing at all - no element is created.
url can be internal (?page=women, ?product=slug) or a full https:// link.

_example.text: New drop: the Resurface denim tee is live in four colorways.
